new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.rankSideSum_one
new_declarations.header: @[simp] theorem rankSideSum_one : rankSideSum 1 = 0

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.rankSideSum_add_two
new_declarations.header:
theorem rankSideSum_add_two (n : Nat) :
    rankSideSum (n + 2) = rankSideSum n + 3 * n + 2

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.rankSideSum_bound
new_declarations.header: theorem rankSideSum_bound (n : Nat) : 4 * rankSideSum n ≤ 3 * n * n

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.four_mul_three_quarters
new_declarations.header: private theorem four_mul_three_quarters : (4 : ℝ≥0∞) * (3 / 4) = 3

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.rankSideSum_mean_le
new_declarations.header:
theorem rankSideSum_mean_le (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (n : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * (rankSideSum n : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞) * n

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.occurrenceRank_lt_of_lt
new_declarations.header:
theorem occurrenceRank_lt_of_lt (xs : List α) (i j : Fin xs.length)
    (hij : xs[i.val] < xs[j.val]) :
    RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id xs i < RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id xs j

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.occurrenceRank_tie
new_declarations.header:
theorem occurrenceRank_tie (xs : List α) (i j : Fin xs.length)
    (hij : i < j) (hvalue : xs[i.val] = xs[j.val]) :
    RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id xs i < RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id xs j

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.occurrenceRank_uniform
new_declarations.header:
theorem occurrenceRank_uniform (head : α) (tail : List α) :
    PMF.map (RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id (head :: tail))
      (RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex tail.length) =
        RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex tail.length

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.filter_length_eq_card_indices
Resources.RandomSelection.strict_side_rank_bounds
new_declarations.header:
theorem strict_side_rank_bounds (xs : List α) (i : Fin xs.length) :
    (partition3 (xs[i.val]'i.isLt) xs).1.length ≤
        (RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id xs i).val ∧
      (partition3 (xs[i.val]'i.isLt) xs).2.2.length ≤
        xs.length - 1 - (RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id xs i).val

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.nextSize
new_declarations.header: def nextSize (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (i : Fin xs.length) : Nat

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.nextSize_le_rankSide
new_declarations.header:
theorem nextSize_le_rankSide (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (i : Fin xs.length) :
    nextSize k xs i ≤
      max (RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id xs i).val
        (xs.length - 1 - (RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id xs i).val)

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.nextSize_sum_le
new_declarations.header:
theorem nextSize_sum_le (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (∑ i : Fin xs.length, nextSize k xs i) ≤ rankSideSum xs.length

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.nextSize_drift
new_declarations.header:
theorem nextSize_drift (k : Nat) (head : α) (tail : List α) :
    (∑ i : Fin (tail.length + 1),
      RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex tail.length i *
        (nextSize k (head :: tail) i : ℝ≥0∞)) ≤
          (3 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞) * (tail.length + 1 : Nat)

new_declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.rank_side_small_values
new_declarations.header:

    rankSideSum 0 = 0 ∧ rankSideSum 1 = 0 ∧ rankSideSum 2 = 2 ∧
      rankSideSum 3 = 5 ∧ rankSideSum 4 = 10 ∧ rankSideSum 5 = 16

new_declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.stable_duplicate_positions
new_declarations.header:
theorem stable_duplicate_positions (x : α) :
    Resources.RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id [x, x] (0 : Fin 2) <
      Resources.RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id [x, x] (1 : Fin 2)

new_declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.refined_duplicate_uniform
new_declarations.header:
theorem refined_duplicate_uniform (x : α) :
    PMF.map (Resources.RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id [x, x])
      (Resources.RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex 1) =
        Resources.RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex 1

new_declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.singleton_next_size
new_declarations.header: theorem singleton_next_size (k : Nat) (x : α) (i : Fin 1) : nextSize k [x] i = 0

new_declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.duplicate_next_choices
new_declarations.header:
theorem duplicate_next_choices (i : Fin 3) :
    nextSize 2 ([0, 0, 1] : List Nat) i = if i = 2 then 0 else 1

new_declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.duplicate_next_expectation
new_declarations.header:
theorem duplicate_next_expectation :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, Resources.RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex 2 i *
      (nextSize 2 ([0, 0, 1] : List Nat) i : ℝ≥0∞)) = (2 : ℝ≥0∞) / 3

new_declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.duplicate_drift_bound
new_declarations.header:
theorem duplicate_drift_bound :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, Resources.RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex 2 i *
      (nextSize 2 ([0, 0, 1] : List Nat) i : ℝ≥0∞)) ≤ (9 : ℝ≥0∞) / 4

new_declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.selected_branch_is_smaller
new_declarations.header:

    nextSize 0 ([0, 1, 2, 3, 4] : List Nat) ⟨1, by decide⟩ = 1 ∧ max 1 3 = 3

new_declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.arbitrary_expected_bounds
new_declarations.header:
theorem arbitrary_expected_bounds (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (xs.length : ℝ) ≤ scanMean k xs ∧ scanMean k xs ≤ 4 * (xs.length : ℝ) ∧
      (xs.length : ℝ) ≤ sourceMean k xs ∧ sourceMean k xs ≤ 36 * (xs.length : ℝ) + 2

new_declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.valid_selection_expected_bounds
new_declarations.header:
theorem valid_selection_expected_bounds (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hk : k < xs.length)
    (result : Outcome α) (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) :
    ∃ a, result.1 = some a ∧ Applications.Selection.RankedAt xs k a ∧
      (xs.length : ℝ) ≤ scanMean k xs ∧ scanMean k xs ≤ 4 * (xs.length : ℝ) ∧
        sourceMean k xs ≤ 36 * (xs.length : ℝ) + 2

new_declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.empty_expected_bounds
new_declarations.header:
theorem empty_expected_bounds (k : Nat) :
    scanMean k ([] : List α) = 0 ∧ sourceMean k ([] : List α) = 2 ∧
      scanMean k ([] : List α) ≤ 0 ∧ sourceMean k ([] : List α) ≤ 2
